verdict.rationale: Bugbot runs automatically on PR events (every PR update and new PRs). Users can shape what happens through `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` rule files, organization-wide rules in Bugbot Automations, and natural-language 'Smart' rules that set the effort level per review. However, the event trigger is fixed to PR review and the single action is posting review comments, so there is no general rule-to-action automation engine. Missing for 10: user-defined event types beyond PR updates, configurable actions other than review comments, detail on what Bugbot Automations can do, and independent corroboration of rule-driven automation.
